answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 slots; agents submit sealed bids, and the top 200 pay the clearing price and lock it for 20 epochs, earning a violet badge. A saffron seal verifies each bid, and an onyx ledger lists winners, exposing duplicates. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 credits, or 60,000 credits locked, above farming rewards. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
